[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-1q5[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Restore TUI speed by ending artifact-index lock starvation[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The TUI stops falling into 24–30 s O(archive) fallback scans. The [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]stranded-work collector holds the artifact-index lock for seconds [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]instead of minutes. A busy lock is answered from the last good [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]snapshot, never a filesystem scan. The smaller UI-thread hitch [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]sources the research found are trimmed. A restarted TUI can then be[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]re-measured mechanically before any GC-policy change.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]3[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]

[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/tui_index_lock_speedup.md[/#87AFFF]

[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Batch the stranded-work session query per project[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]stranded-batch[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]stranded-batch: replace the per-assignee index query loop with one [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]batched, chunked query per project, keeping the exact recheck and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dedupe, with parity tests and a before/after timing.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Throttle and memoize stranded reports[/bold #D7AFFF]                         [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]stranded-cadence[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]stranded-cadence: raise the stranded report TTL to 60 s, floor forced [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]recomputes, drop the dead beads_watcher force source, and memoize [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]per-tick stranded project keys, verdict indexes, and counts.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Never answer a busy index lock with a source scan[/bold #D7AFFF]             [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]loader-lock-busy[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]loader-lock-busy: serve the last good tier-1 snapshot or keep the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]current roster when the index lock is busy, retry through existing [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]flags, log artifact_source and repair_reason on slow loads, and document[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the lock's invariants.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Indexed session lookup in sase-core[/bold #D7AFFF]                           [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]core-session-lookup[dim] · [dim][/dim]after stranded-batch[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]core-session-lookup: push agent_session/agent_name equality filters into[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]SQL with NOCASE indexes, fix the workflow-scoped reconcile deletion bug,[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]keep the Rust post-filter, and move the sase-core pin.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Trim Agents-tab tick and capacity patch work[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
